qEn: Which of the following is the longest river in India?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से भारत की सबसे लंबी नदी कौन सी है?
explainEn: The Ganga is the longest river originating within India, with a total length of over 2,500 km.

qEn: Which article of the Indian Constitution deals with the Right to Equality?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद समानता के अधिकार से संबंधित है?
explainEn: Articles 14 to 18 of the Indian Constitution guarantee the Right to Equality.

qEn: Bihu is a traditional dance/festival associated with which Indian state?
qHi: बिहू किस भारतीय राज्य से संबंधित एक पारंपरिक नृत्य/उत्सव है?
explainEn: Bihu is a set of three cultural festivals of Assam celebrated in the Assamese calendar months.

qEn: Which planet in our solar system is known as the Red Planet?
qHi: हमारे सौरमंडल में किस ग्रह को लाल ग्रह के रूप में जाना जाता है?
explainEn: Mars is called the Red Planet because of the iron oxide prevalent on its surface.

qEn: The headquarters of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is located in:
qHi: भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक (RBI) का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
explainEn: The central office of the Reserve Bank of India has been permanently located in Mumbai since 1937.

qEn: Which vitamin is abundantly found in citrus fruits like lemon and orange?
qHi: नींबू और संतरे जैसे खट्टे फलों में प्रचुर मात्रा में कौन सा विटामिन पाया जाता है?
explainEn: Citrus fruits are rich sources of Vitamin C, which is essential for growth and repair of tissues.

qEn: Which Article of the Indian Constitution defines the right to equality before law?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद कानून के समक्ष समानता के अधिकार को परिभाषित करता है?
explainEn: Article 14 of the Indian Constitution states that the State shall not deny to any person equality before the law or the equal protection of the laws.

qEn: The famous monument Gateway of India is located in which city?
qHi: प्रसिद्ध स्मारक गेटवे ऑफ़ इंडिया किस शहर में स्थित है?
explainEn: The Gateway of India is an arch-monument built during the 20th century in Mumbai.

qEn: Who was the first Indian woman to go into space?
qHi: अंतरिक्ष में जाने वाली पहली भारतीय महिला कौन थीं?
explainEn: Kalpana Chawla was an American astronaut and engineer who was the first woman of Indian origin to go to space.

qEn: Bihu is a traditional dance and festival associated with which Indian state?
qHi: बिहू किस भारतीय राज्य से संबंधित एक पारंपरिक नृत्य और उत्सव है?
explainEn: Bihu is a set of three cultural festivals of Assam and represents the folk dance associated with it.

qEn: What is the standard unit of measurement for electrical resistance?
qHi: विद्युत प्रतिरोध की माप की मानक इकाई क्या है?
explainEn: The ohm is the SI unit of electrical resistance, named after physicist Georg Ohm.

qEn: Which of the following mountain passes connects Srinagar with Leh?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा दर्रा श्रीनगर को लेह से जोड़ता है?
explainEn: Zoji La is a high mountain pass in Ladakh, situated on the Srinagar-Leh highway in the Himalayan mountain range.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Geography - India: Physical Environment

qEn: The Tropic of Cancer passes through which of the following groups of Indian states?
qHi: कर्क रेखा निम्नलिखित में से किस भारतीय राज्य समूह से होकर गुजरती है?
optsEn: Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Bihar, Tripura
optsHi: उत्तर प्रदेश, मध्य प्रदेश, बिहार, त्रिपुरा
explainEn: The Tropic of Cancer (23.30° N) passes through eight Indian states: Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura, and Mizoram.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 9 Geography - Contemporary India I

qEn: Which Article of the Indian Constitution provides for the appointment of the Prime Minister and other Ministers?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद प्रधानमंत्री और अन्य मंत्रियों की नियुक्ति का प्रावधान करता है?
explainEn: Article 75 of the Indian Constitution states that the Prime Minister shall be appointed by the President and the other Ministers shall be appointed by the President on the advice of the Prime Minister.

qEn: During whose viceroyalty was the Vernacular Press Act enacted in 1878?
qHi: किस वायसराय के कार्यकाल के दौरान 1878 में वर्नाक्युलर प्रेस एक्ट पारित किया गया था?
explainEn: The Vernacular Press Act of 1878 was enacted during the viceroyalty of Lord Lytton to curtail the freedom of the Indian-language press.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 12 History - Themes in Indian History Part III

qEn: Which of the following is the highest waterfall in India?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से भारत का सबसे ऊँचा जलप्रपात कौन सा है?
explainEn: Kunchikal Falls, located in the Shimoga district of Karnataka, is the highest waterfall in India, formed by the Varahi river.

qEn: What is the primary gas responsible for the greenhouse effect on the planet Venus?
qHi: शुक्र ग्रह पर ग्रीनहाउस प्रभाव के लिए उत्तरदायी मुख्य गैस कौन सी है?
explainEn: The atmosphere of Venus is composed of about 96.5% carbon dioxide, which creates a runaway greenhouse effect making it the hottest planet.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 6 Geography - The Earth in Our Solar System

qEn: The Battle of Buxar was fought in which year?
qHi: बक्सर का युद्ध किस वर्ष लड़ा गया था?
explainEn: The Battle of Buxar was fought on October 22, 1764, between the British forces led by Hector Munro and the combined army of Mir Kasim, Shuja-ud-Daula, and Shah Alam II.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 8 History - Our Pasts III

qEn: Which organelle in a plant cell is responsible for photosynthesis?
qHi: पादप कोशिका का कौन सा अंगक प्रकाश संश्लेषण के लिए उत्तरदायी है?
explainEn: Chloroplasts contain chlorophyll which absorbs sunlight and carries out photosynthesis in plant cells.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 9 Science - Fundamental Unit of Life

qEn: Which of the following is a Kharif crop in India?
qHi: भारत में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी एक खरीफ फसल है?
explainEn: Paddy is a major Kharif crop sown during the monsoon season in India.

qEn: Which article of the Indian Constitution deals with the right to equality before law?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद कानून के समक्ष समानता के अधिकार से संबंधित है?
explainEn: Article 14 of the Constitution of India guarantees equality before law and equal protection of the laws.

qEn: What is the standard unit of measuring atmospheric pressure?
qHi: वायुमंडलीय दबाव मापने की मानक इकाई क्या है?
explainEn: Pascal is the SI unit of pressure, including atmospheric pressure.

qEn: In which state is the Gir National Park located?
qHi: गीर राष्ट्रीय उद्यान किस राज्य में स्थित है?
explainEn: Gir National Park and Wildlife Sanctuary is located in the state of Gujarat and is famous for Asiatic lions.
sourceHint: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

qEn: Which river basin is the Bhakra Nangal Dam built across?
qHi: भाखड़ा नांगल बांध किस नदी बेसिन पर बनाया गया है?
explainEn: The Bhakra Nangal Dam is constructed on the Sutlej River.

qEn: Who appoints the Chief Justice of India?
qHi: भारत के मुख्य न्यायाधीश की नियुक्ति कौन करता है?
explainEn: The Chief Justice of India and other judges of the Supreme Court are appointed by the President of India.

qEn: Which vitamin is primarily obtained from sunlight by the human body?
qHi: मानव शरीर द्वारा धूप से मुख्य रूप से कौन सा विटामिन प्राप्त किया जाता है?
explainEn: Vitamin D is synthesized in the skin upon exposure to sunlight.

qEn: Which article of the Indian Constitution provides for the establishment of a Finance Commission?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद वित्त आयोग की स्थापना का प्रावधान करता है?
explainEn: Article 280 of the Constitution of India provides for a Finance Commission as a quasi-judicial body constituted by the President.

qEn: Who was the founder of the Satavahana dynasty?
qHi: सातवाहन वंश का संस्थापक कौन था?
explainEn: Simukha was the founder of the Satavahana dynasty in the 1st century BCE.

qEn: The Barail Range is located in which part of India?
qHi: बराईल श्रेणी भारत के किस भाग में स्थित है?
explainEn: The Barail Range is a hill range running from Assam to Manipur through Nagaland in North-East India.

qEn: Which constitutional amendment Act reduced the voting age from 21 years to 18 years in India?
qHi: किस संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम द्वारा भारत में मतदान की आयु 21 वर्ष से घटाकर 18 वर्ष की गई?
explainEn: The 61st Constitutional Amendment Act, 1988 lowered the voting age of elections to the Lok Sabha and Legislative Assemblies from 21 to 18 years.

qEn: Badminton World Federation (BWF) headquarters is located in which country?
qHi: बैडमिंटन वर्ल्ड फेडरेशन (BWF) का मुख्यालय किस देश में स्थित है?
explainEn: The headquarters of the Badminton World Federation is located in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
sourceHint: Official BWF statutes and Olympic governing bodies directory

qEn: Which chemical compound is commonly known as Blue Vitriol?
qHi: किस रासायनिक यौगिक को सामान्यतः नीला थोथा (Blue Vitriol) कहा जाता है?
explainEn: Copper(II) sulfate pentahydrate is commonly known as blue vitriol.

qEn: Which of the following Fundamental Rights cannot be suspended even during a National Emergency under the Indian Constitution?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान के तहत राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल के दौरान भी निम्नलिखित में से किस मौलिक अधिकार को निलंबित नहीं किया जा सकता है?
explainEn: By the 44th Amendment Act, Articles 20 (protection in respect of conviction for offenses) and 21 (protection of life and personal liberty) cannot be suspended during a National Emergency.

qEn: What is the standard unit of SI for measuring thermodynamic temperature?
qHi: ऊष्मप्रवैगिक तापमान को मापने के लिए एसआई की मानक इकाई क्या है?
explainEn: Kelvin is the base unit of thermodynamic temperature in the International System of Units (SI).

qEn: Which vitamins are water-soluble in human nutrition?
qHi: मानव पोषण में कौन से विटामिन पानी में घुलनशील हैं?
explainEn: Vitamin B-complex and Vitamin C are water-soluble, whereas Vitamins A, D, E, and K are fat-soluble.

qEn: Which Harappan site is famous for its dockyard?
qHi: कौन सा हड़प्पा स्थल अपने गोदीबाड़ा (डॉकयार्ड) के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
explainEn: Lothal, located in Gujarat, is well known for the discovery of a massive tidal dockyard.

qEn: What is the chemical formula for ordinary table salt?
qHi: साधारण नमक का रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
explainEn: Sodium chloride, with the chemical formula NaCl, is the salt commonly used as table salt.

qEn: During the Gupta Empire, the officer known as 'Sandhivigrahika' was responsible for which of the following portfolios?
qHi: गुप्त साम्राज्य के दौरान, 'संधिविग्रहिक' के रूप में जाने जाने वाले अधिकारी की जिम्मेदारी निम्नलिखित में से किस विभाग की थी?
optsEn: Chief Justice of the supreme court
explainEn: In the Gupta administration, Sandhivigrahika was the minister for war and peace, responsible for foreign affairs and framing peace treaties.

qEn: Who among the following founded the Atmiya Sabha in the year 1815?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से किसने वर्ष 1815 में आत्मीय सभा की स्थापना ਕੀਤੀ थी?
explainEn: Raja Ram Mohan Roy founded Atmiya Sabha in 1815 as a philosophical discussion circle in Kolkata to campaign against social evils.

qEn: What is the chemical formula of the compound commonly known as washing soda?
qHi: सामान्यतः वाशिंग सोडा (धोने का सोडा) के रूप में जाने जाने वाले यौगिक का रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
explainEn: Washing soda is sodium carbonate decahydrate, chemically represented as Na2CO3.10H2O.

qEn: Which of the following biosphere reserves is located in the state of Meghalaya?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा जीवमंडल आरक्षित क्षेत्र (बायोस्फीयर रिजर्व) मेघालय राज्य में स्थित है?
explainEn: Nokrek Biosphere Reserve is located in the West Garo Hills district of Meghalaya.
sourceHint: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, India

qEn: Which article of the Indian Constitution deals with the abolition of untouchability?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद अस्पृश्यता के अंत से संबंधित है?
explainEn: Article 17 of the Constitution of India abolishes untouchability and forbids its practice in any form.

qEn: What is the standard meridian of India?
qHi: भारत की मानक मध्याह्न रेखा कौन सी है?
explainEn: The 82.5 degree East longitude passing through Mirzapur is taken as the Standard Meridian of India.

qEn: Which vitamin deficiency causes scurvy?
qHi: किस विटामिन की कमी से स्कर्वी रोग होता है?
explainEn: Scurvy is caused by a deficiency of Vitamin C, which is commonly found in citrus fruits.

qEn: Which instrument is used to measure atmospheric pressure?
qHi: वायुमंडलीय दबाव मापने के लिए किस उपकरण का उपयोग किया जाता है?
explainEn: A barometer is a scientific instrument used in meteorology to measure atmospheric pressure.

qEn: The Battle of Plassey was fought in which year?
qHi: प्लासी का युद्ध किस वर्ष लड़ा गया था?
explainEn: The Battle of Plassey was fought in 1757 between the British East India Company and the Nawab of Bengal.

qEn: Which mountain range separates the Indo-Gangetic Plain from the Deccan Plateau?
qHi: कौन सी पर्वत श्रृंखला भारत-गंगा के मैदान को दक्कन के पठार से अलग करती है?
explainEn: The Vindhya range traditionally marks the boundary between the northern Indo-Gangetic plains and the southern Deccan plateau.

qEn: Who was the founder of the Maurya Empire in ancient India?
qHi: प्राचीन भारत में मौर्य साम्राज्य के संस्थापक कौन थे?
explainEn: Chandragupta Maurya founded the Maurya Empire with the help of Chanakya by overthrowing the Nanda Dynasty.

qEn: Which wind system brings rainfall to the majority of India during the summer months?
qHi: ग्रीष्मकालीन महीनों में भारत के अधिकांश हिस्से में कौन सी पवन प्रणाली वर्षा लाती है?
explainEn: The South-West Monsoon is the primary rain-bearing wind system affecting the Indian subcontinent during summer.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Geography - India: Physical Environment

qEn: In which year was the first session of the Indian National Congress held?
qHi: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस का प्रथम अधिवेशन किस वर्ष आयोजित किया गया था?
explainEn: The first session of the Indian National Congress was held in Bombay in December 1885, presided over by W.C. Bonnerjee.

qEn: Which chemical element has the highest electrical conductivity at room temperature?
qHi: कमरे के तापमान पर किस रासायनिक तत्व की विद्युत चालकता सबसे अधिक होती है?
explainEn: Silver has the highest electrical conductivity, thermal conductivity, and reflectivity of any metal.

qEn: Which of the following biosphere reserves was the first to be established in India?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा बायोस्फीयर रिजर्व भारत में स्थापित होने वाला पहला था?
explainEn: The Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve was established in 1986 as India's first biosphere reserve.
sourceHint: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Government of India

qEn: Which of the following is the standard meridian of India?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी भारत की मानक यम्योत्तर रेखा है?
explainEn: The 82 degree 30 minute East longitude passing through Mirzapur is taken as the Indian Standard Time meridian.

qEn: Kolkata port is situated on the banks of which river?
qHi: कोलकाता बंदरगाह किस नदी के तट पर स्थित है?
explainEn: Kolkata port is a riverine port situated on the banks of the Hooghly River.

qEn: What is the chemical formula of common salt?
qHi: साधारण नमक का रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
explainEn: Common salt is chemically known as sodium chloride, represented by the formula NaCl.

qEn: Which vitamin is essential for the coagulation of blood?
qHi: रक्त का थक्का जमने के लिए कौन सा विटामिन आवश्यक है?
explainEn: Vitamin K plays a major role in blood clotting and wound healing.

qEn: Which state in India has the maximum forest cover in terms of absolute area?
qHi: क्षेत्रफल की दृष्टि से भारत के किस राज्य में सर्वाधिक वनावरण है?
explainEn: According to the India State of Forest Report, Madhya Pradesh has the largest forest cover in terms of area.
sourceHint: Ministry of Environment Forest and Climate Change

qEn: At which of the following Indus Valley Civilization sites was a dockyard found?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से किस सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता स्थल से गोदीबाड़ा (डॉकयार्ड) मिला था?
explainEn: Lothal, located in Gujarat, is famous for the discovery of a massive tidal dockyard, indicating maritime trade.

qEn: Which of the following atmospheric layers is closest to the Earth's surface?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी वायुमंडलीय परत पृथ्वी की सतह के सबसे निकट है?
explainEn: The troposphere is the lowest layer of Earth's atmosphere, extending from the surface up to about 8-15 km.

qEn: Sonal Mansingh is a renowned classical dancer associated with which dance forms?
qHi: सonal मानसिंह एक प्रसिद्ध शास्त्रीय नृत्यांगना हैं जो किस नृत्य शैली से जुड़ी हैं?
explainEn: Sonal Mansingh is an eminent Indian classical dancer proficient in both Bharatanatyam and Odissi.

qEn: Kaziranga National Park, famous for the one-horned rhinoceros, is situated in which state?
qHi: एक सींग वाले गैंडे के लिए प्रसिद्ध काजीरंगा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान किस राज्य में स्थित है?
explainEn: Kaziranga National Park is located in the Golaghat and Nagaon districts of Assam.

qEn: Kaziranga National Park is primarily famous for the conservation of which animal?
qHi: काजीरंगा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान मुख्य रूप से किस जानवर के संरक्षण के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
explainEn: Kaziranga National Park in Assam hosts two-thirds of the world's great one-horned rhinoceroses.

qEn: Which vitamin is commonly known as Ascorbic Acid?
qHi: किस विटामिन को सामान्यतः एस्कॉर्बिक एसिड कहा जाता है?
explainEn: Vitamin C is a water-soluble vitamin also known by its chemical name ascorbic acid.

qEn: Which constitutional amendment introduced the provisions relating to Municipalities (Urban Local Government) in India?
qHi: किस संवैधानिक संशोधन द्वारा भारत में नगर पालिकाओं (शहरी स्थानीय सरकार) से संबंधित प्रावधानों को पेश किया गया था?
explainEn: The 74th Constitutional Amendment Act of 1992 added Part IX-A to the Constitution, relating to Municipalities.

qEn: During the British colonial rule in India, the 'Wood's Despatch' of 1854 was primarily concerned with which of the following?
qHi: भारत में ब्रिटिश औपनिवेशिक शासन के दौरान, 1854 का 'वुड्स डिस्पैच' मुख्य रूप से किससे संबंधित था?
explainEn: Charles Wood's Despatch on Education in 1854 is often considered the Magna Carta of English education in India.

qEn: Under the Rigvedic society, the term 'Purohita' referred to which of the following?
qHi: ऋग्वैदिक समाज के अंतर्गत, 'पुरोहित' शब्द किसे संदर्भित करता था?
explainEn: In the Rigvedic period, the Purohita was the chief priest and advisor to the king.

qEn: Which Indian state has the maximum length of national highways as per recent Ministry of Road Transport and Highways data?
qHi: सड़क परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय के हालिया आंकड़ों के अनुसार किस भारतीय राज्य में राष्ट्रीय राजमार्गों की लंबाई सबसे अधिक है?
explainEn: Maharashtra holds the position for having the maximum total length of national highways among Indian states according to official transport statistics.
sourceHint: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways Annual Report

qEn: The term 'Operation Polo' is historically associated with which of the following events in Indian history?
qHi: भारतीय इतिहास में 'ऑपरेशन पोलो' शब्द ऐतिहासिक रूप से निम्नलिखित में से किस घटना से जुड़ा है?
optsEn: Liberation of Dadra and Nagar Haveli
optsHi: दादरा और नगर हवेली की मुक्ति
explainEn: Operation Polo was the code name for the police action in September 1948 by the Government of India against the Princely State of Hyderabad.

qEn: Which of the following is a classic example of a 'Block Mountain' (Horst)?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा 'ब्लॉक पर्वत' (हॉर्स) का एक उत्कृष्ट उदाहरण है?
explainEn: The Black Forest mountains in Germany and the Vosges in France are classic examples of block mountains formed by faulting.
sourceHint: Certificate Physical and Human Geography by Goh Cheng Leong

qEn: In the context of Indian monetary policy, the term 'Marginal Standing Facility' (MSF) allows scheduled banks to borrow funds overnight from which institution?
qHi: भारतीय मौद्रिक नीति के संदर्भ में, 'मार्जिनल स्टैंडिंग फैसिलिटी' (MSF) अनुसूचित बैंकों को किस संस्था से रातों-रात धन उधार लेने की अनुमति देती है?
explainEn: MSF is a window for scheduled commercial banks to borrow overnight from the Reserve Bank of India in emergency situations.

qEn: Which of the following fundamental rights is guaranteed under Article 21 of the Indian Constitution?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान के अनुच्छेद 21 के तहत निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा मौलिक अधिकार की गारंटी दी गई है?
optsEn: Right to protection of life and personal liberty
optsHi: जीवन और व्यक्तिगत स्वतंत्रता की सुरक्षा का अधिकार
explainEn: Article 21 of the Constitution of India declares that no person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law.

qEn: What is the standard chemical formula for water?
qHi: पानी का मानक रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
explainEn: A water molecule consists of two hydrogen atoms bonded to one oxygen atom, giving it the chemical formula H2O.

qEn: Who among the following was the founder of the Satavahana dynasty?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से सातवाहन वंश का संस्थापक कौन था?
explainEn: Simukha was the founder of the Satavahana dynasty in the 1st century BCE.

qEn: The Khilji dynasty was succeeded by which of the following dynasties in the Delhi Sultanate?
qHi: दिल्ली सल्तनत में खिलजी वंश के बाद निम्नलिखित में से किस वंश ने शासन किया?
explainEn: The Tughlaq dynasty succeeded the Khilji dynasty and ruled the Delhi Sultanate from 1320 to 1414.

qEn: The Bailadila range in Chhattisgarh is famous for the mining of which of the following minerals?
qHi: छत्तीसगढ़ की बैलाडिला श्रेणी निम्नलिखित में से किस खनिज के खनन के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
explainEn: Bailadila hill range is located in the Dantewada district of Chhattisgarh and is renowned for high-grade hematite iron ore deposits.

qEn: At which of the following Buddhist Councils was the Buddhism split into Sthaviravada and Mahasanghika?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से किस बौद्ध संगीति में बौद्ध धर्म स्थविरवाद और महासांगिक में विभाजित हुआ?
explainEn: The permanent schism dividing Buddhism into Sthaviravada and Mahasanghika occurred during the Second Buddhist Council held at Vaishali.

qEn: Which article of the Indian Constitution provides for the establishment of a Joint Public Service Commission for two or more States?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद दो या दो से अधिक राज्यों के लिए एक संयुक्त लोक सेवा आयोग की स्थापना का प्रावधान करता है?
explainEn: Article 315 of the Indian Constitution deals with Public Service Commissions for the Union and for the States, including the provision for a Joint Public Service Commission.

qEn: The 'Dampa Tiger Reserve' is located in which of the following Indian states?
qHi: डम्पा टाइगर रिजर्व निम्नलिखित में से किस भारतीय राज्य में स्थित है?
explainEn: Dampa Tiger Reserve is a wildlife sanctuary and tiger reserve located in the West Phaileng sub-division of Mizoram.

qEn: Which of the following mountain passes connects the Kullu Valley with the Lahaul Valley in Himachal Pradesh?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा दर्रा हिमाचल प्रदेश में कुल्लू घाटी को लाहुल घाटी से जोड़ता है?
explainEn: Rohtang Pass is a high mountain pass on the eastern end of the Pir Panjal Range of the Himalayas, connecting the Kullu and Lahaul-Spiti valleys.

qEn: The 'Sattriya' dance form, recognized as one of the classical dances of India, belongs primarily to which of the following states?
qHi: सत्रिया नृत्य शैली, जिसे भारत के शास्त्रीय नृत्यों में से एक के रूप में मान्यता प्राप्त है, मुख्य रूप से निम्नलिखित में से किस राज्य से संबंधित है?
explainEn: Sattriya is a classical dance-drama performance art originating from the Indian state of Assam, introduced by the 15th-century Bhakti movement saint Srimanta Sankardev.
sourceHint: Ministry of Culture, Government of India

qEn: In the context of Indian monetary policy, which of the following instruments is considered a qualitative (selective) tool of credit control?
qHi: भारतीय मौद्रिक नीति के संदर्भ में, निम्नलिखित में से किस उपकरण को साख नियंत्रण का गुणात्मक (चयननात्मक) उपकरण माना जाता है?
explainEn: Margin requirements are a qualitative tool used by the central bank to regulate the specific uses of credit, unlike quantitative tools like CRR, Bank Rate, and OMO which affect the overall volume of money.

qEn: Which of the following gases is predominantly responsible for the phenomenon of photochemical smog?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी गैस फोटोकैमिकल स्मॉग (प्रकाशीय रासायनिक धुंध) की घटना के लिए प्रमुख रूप से जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: Photochemical smog is formed when nitrogen oxides and volatile organic compounds react with sunlight, creating a brown haze.

qEn: The 'Indus Valley Civilization' site of Lothal is situated on the banks of which of the following rivers?
qHi: सिंधु घाटी सभ्यता का स्थल लोथल निम्नलिखित में से किस नदी के तट पर स्थित है?
explainEn: Lothal, known for its dockyard, was an important trading city of the Indus Valley Civilization located on the banks of the Bhogavo river, a tributary of the Sabarmati, in Gujarat.

qEn: Bihu is a traditional dance festival celebrated in which Indian state?
qHi: बिहू किस भारतीय राज्य में मनाया जाने वाला एक पारंपरिक नृत्य उत्सव है?
explainEn: Bihu is a set of three cultural festivals of Assam celebrated across the year.

qEn: Which historical monument was built by Qutb-ud-din Aibak in Delhi?
qHi: दिल्ली में कुतुबुद्दीन ऐबक द्वारा कौन सा ऐतिहासिक स्मारक बनवाया गया था?
explainEn: The construction of Qutub Minar was started by Qutb-ud-din Aibak around 1199.

qEn: Kolkata is situated on the banks of which river?
qHi: कोलकाता किस नदी کے तट पर स्थित है?
explainEn: Kolkata is located on the eastern bank of the Hooghly River.

qEn: Which of the following movements was suspended by Mahatma Gandhi due to the Chauri Chaura incident?
qHi: चौरी चौरा घटना के कारण महात्मा गांधी ने निम्नलिखित में से किस आंदोलन को स्थगित कर दिया था?
explainEn: Mahatma Gandhi suspended the Non-Cooperation Movement in February 1922 following the violent Chauri Chaura incident in Gorakhpur.

qEn: What is the primary gas responsible for the greenhouse effect on Venus?
qHi: शुक्र ग्रह पर ग्रीनहाउस प्रभाव के लिए उत्तरदायी मुख्य गैस कौन सी है?
explainEn: The atmosphere of Venus is composed of about 96.5 percent carbon dioxide, which creates a strong greenhouse effect.

qEn: Which plateau is known as the mineral storehouse of India?
qHi: किस पठार को भारत का खनिज भंडार कहा जाता है?
explainEn: The Chota Nagpur Plateau is rich in mineral resources such as coal, iron ore, mica, and bauxite, earning it the title of mineral storehouse of India.

qEn: Who appoints the Comptroller and Auditor General of India?
qHi: भारत के नियंत्रक-महालेखापरीक्षक की नियुक्ति कौन करता है?
explainEn: Under Article 148 of the Constitution, the Comptroller and Auditor General of India is appointed by the President of India.

qEn: The Sarnath Pillar inscription belongs to which Mauryan Emperor?
qHi: सारनाथ स्तंभ का शिलालेख किस मौर्य सम्राट से संबंधित है?
explainEn: The Lion Capital of Ashoka at Sarnath is a famous pillar edict erected by the Mauryan Emperor Ashoka.

qEn: Which constitutional amendment introduced the provision for tribunals under Articles 323A and 323B in the Constitution of India?
qHi: भारत के संविधान में किस संवैधानिक संशोधन द्वारा अनुच्छेद 323A और 323B के तहत न्यायाधिकरणों का प्रावधान पेश किया गया था?
explainEn: The 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act of 1976 added Part XIV-A to the Constitution, containing Articles 323A for administrative tribunals and 323B for tribunals for other matters.
sourceHint: Indian Polity by M. Laxmikanth / NCERT

qEn: In which physiographic division of India is the Karewa formation prominently found?
qHi: भारत के किस भौतिक-आकृतिक विभाग में करेवा संरचना प्रमुख रूप से पाई जाती है?
explainEn: Karewas are lacustrine deposits (deposits in glacial lakes) found in the Kashmir Himalayas, famous for the cultivation of saffron.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Geography - India: Physical Environment

qEn: During the reign of which Delhi Sultan was the department of agriculture, known as Diwan-i-Kohi, established?
qHi: किस दिल्ली सल्तनत के शासनकाल में कृषि विभाग, जिसे दीवान-ए-कोही के रूप में जाना जाता है, स्थापित किया गया था?
explainEn: Muhammad bin Tughlaq established the agricultural department called Diwan-i-Kohi to bring uncultivated land under cultivation by giving direct financial support to peasants.

qEn: Which tropical cyclone monitoring satellite was successfully launched jointly by NASA and ISRO?
qHi: NASA और ISRO द्वारा संयुक्त रूप से किस उष्णकटिबंधीय चक्रवात निगरानी उपग्रह को सफलतापूर्वक लॉन्च किया गया था?
explainEn: Megha-Tropiques was a Indo-French joint satellite mission for studying the tropical atmosphere and climate cycle, with ISRO providing the launch and operational support, while CNES (France) collaborated. Wait, NISAR is NASA-ISRO. Let's correct the question topic to avoid ambiguity, or use Megha-Tropiques which was ISRO-CNES. Let's substitute with a solid Gupta period art fact instead.

qEn: The famous iron pillar of Mehrauli in Delhi, which has not rusted for over 1600 years, belongs to the period of which Gupta ruler?
qHi: दिल्ली में महरौली का प्रसिद्ध लौह स्तंभ, जो 1600 वर्षों से अधिक समय से जंग नहीं खाया है, किस गुप्त शासक के काल का है?
explainEn: The Mehrauli Iron Pillar bears an inscription in Sanskrit in Brahmi script stating that it was erected as a standard of Lord Vishnu on the hill known as Vishnupada in memory of a mighty king named Chandra, identified with Chandragupta II.

qEn: Which specific Article of the Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP) directs the State to organize Village Panchayats?
qHi: राज्य के नीति निर्देशक तत्वों (DPSP) का कौन सा विशिष्ट अनुच्छेद राज्य को ग्राम पंचायतों को व्यवस्थित करने का निर्देश देता है?
explainEn: Article 40 of the Constitution of India, which is one of the Gandhian principles under DPSP, directs the State to organize village panchayats and endow them with necessary powers.

qEn: What is the primary mineral composition of the Earth's continental crust?
qHi: पृथ्वी की महाद्वीपीय क्रस्ट (पर्पटी) की प्राथमिक खनिज संरचना क्या है?
explainEn: The upper continental crust is primarily composed of silica and aluminium, commonly referred to as Sial.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 11 Geography - Fundamentals of Physical Geography

qEn: Which of the following atmospheric layers contains the ozone layer that absorbs harmful ultraviolet radiation?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से किस वायुमंडलीय परत में ओजोन परत होती है जो हानिकारक पराबैंगनी विकिरण को अवशोषित करती है?
explainEn: The stratosphere contains the ozone layer, which absorbs the sun's ultraviolet radiation, protecting life on Earth.

qEn: Which article of the Indian Constitution defines the 'Right to Equality'?
qHi: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद 'समानता का अधिकार' परिभाषित करता है?
explainEn: Articles 14 to 18 of the Constitution of India guarantee the Right to Equality.

qEn: Which dance form originates from the state of Kerala?
qHi: कौन सा नृत्य रूप केरल राज्य से उत्पन्न हुआ है?
explainEn: Kathakali is a major classical Indian dance form that originated in Kerala.
sourceHint: Ministry of Culture, Government of India

qEn: What is the standard unit of electric current in the SI system?
qHi: SI प्रणाली में विद्युत धारा की मानक इकाई क्या है?
explainEn: The Ampere is the SI base unit of electric current.

qEn: Which historical site is famous for rock-cut cave architecture located in Maharashtra?
qHi: महाराष्ट्र में स्थित कौन सा ऐतिहासिक स्थल शैल-कृत गुफा वास्तुकला के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
explainEn: The Ajanta Caves in Maharashtra are world-famous monuments featuring rock-cut cave architecture.

qEn: Which of the following mountain passes connects Kullu Valley with Lahaul and Spiti Valleys in Himachal Pradesh?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा दर्रा हिमाचल प्रदेश में कुल्लू घाटी को लाहुल और स्पीति घाटियों से जोड़ता है?
explainEn: Rohtang Pass is a high mountain pass on the eastern end of the Pir Panjal Range of the Himalayas, connecting the Kullu Valley with the Lahaul and Spiti valleys of Himachal Pradesh.

qEn: What is the primary commercial product extracted from the bark of the Cinchona tree?
qHi: सिनकोना के पेड़ की छाल से निकाला जाने वाला मुख्य व्यावसायिक उत्पाद क्या है?
explainEn: Quinine is a medication used to treat malaria, which is traditionally extracted from the bark of the Cinchona tree.

qEn: Which of the following battles effectively established British supremacy in Bengal?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से किस युद्ध ने बंगाल में ब्रिटिश सर्वोच्चता को प्रभावी रूप से स्थापित किया?
explainEn: While the Battle of Plassey (1757) laid the foundation, the Battle of Buxar (1764) firmly established British political and military control and supremacy over Bengal and northern India.

qEn: Which Indian state shares the maximum length of its international boundary with Myanmar?
qHi: कौन सा भारतीय राज्य म्यांमार के साथ अपनी अंतरराष्ट्रीय सीमा की सबसे अधिक लंबाई साझा करता है?
explainEn: Arunachal Pradesh shares the longest international boundary with Myanmar among all the bordering Indian states.
sourceHint: Survey of India / Ministry of Home Affairs

qEn: Which cell organelles are known as the 'powerhouses of the cell' due to their role in ATP production?
qHi: एटीपी उत्पादन में उनकी भूमिका के कारण किस कोशिका अंग को 'कोशिका का पावरहाउस' कहा जाता है?
explainEn: Mitochondria generate most of the chemical energy needed to power the cell's biochemical reactions, earning them the title 'powerhouses of the cell'.

qEn: Who among the following was the founder of the Satyashodhak Samaj in 1873?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन 1873 में सत्यशोधक समाज के संस्थापक थे?
explainEn: Jyotirao Phule founded the Satyashodhak Samaj (Society of Seekers of Truth) on 24 September 1873 to advocate for the education and rights of lower castes in Maharashtra.
sourceHint: NCERT History - Our Pasts / Modern India

qEn: Which of the following fundamental rights prohibits human trafficking and forced labor in India?
qHi: भारत में निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा मौलिक अधिकार मानव तस्करी और जबरन श्रम पर प्रतिबंध लगाता है?
explainEn: Article 23 of the Indian Constitution, under the Right against Exploitation, prohibits human trafficking and begar (forced labor).
sourceHint: Constitution of India, Part III - Fundamental Rights

qEn: What is the standard meridian longitude of India used to determine Indian Standard Time?
qHi: भारतीय मानक समय निर्धारित करने के लिए उपयोग की जाने वाली भारत की मानक याम्योत्तर देशांतर रेखा कौन सी है?
explainEn: Indian Standard Time is calculated on the basis of 82.5° E longitude, passing through Mirzapur in Uttar Pradesh.

qEn: Which vitamin deficiency causes the disease known as scurvy?
qHi: किस विटामिन की कमी के कारण स्कर्वी नामक रोग होता है?
explainEn: Scurvy is caused by a deficiency of Vitamin C, which is commonly found in citrus fruits.

qEn: Bihu is a traditional folk dance celebrated in which Indian state?
qHi: बिहू किस भारतीय राज्य में मनाया जाने वाला एक पारंपरिक लोक नृत्य है?
explainEn: Bihu is a set of three cultural dances of Assam and is associated with the Bihu festivals.
sourceHint: Centre for Cultural Resources and Training (CCRT)

qEn: In which year was the Reserve Bank of India established?
qHi: भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक की स्थापना किस वर्ष हुई थी?
explainEn: The Reserve Bank of India was established on April 1, 1935, in accordance with the provisions of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.

qEn: What is the standard meridian longitude of India?
qHi: भारत की मानक याम्योत्तर देशांतर रेखा कौन सी है?
explainEn: The 82 degree 30 minute East meridian is used as India's Standard Time.

qEn: Which vitamin is predominantly found in citrus fruits like oranges and lemons?
qHi: संतरे और नींबू जैसे खट्टे फलों में मुख्य रूप से कौन सा विटामिन पाया जाता है?
explainEn: Citrus fruits are rich sources of Vitamin C, also known as ascorbic acid.

qEn: Which river basin is the largest in India?
qHi: भारत में कौन सा नदी बेसिन सबसे बड़ा है?
explainEn: The Ganga basin is the largest river basin in India, covering a vast area of the northern plains.

qEn: Which of the following layers of the atmosphere is primarily responsible for the reflection of radio waves back to Earth?
qHi: वायुमंडल की निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी परत रेडियो तरंगों को वापस पृथ्वी पर परावर्तित करने के लिए मुख्य रूप से जिम्मेदार है?
explainEn: The Ionosphere contains electrically charged particles that reflect radio waves back to the Earth's surface.

qEn: In which year was the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) nationalized?
qHi: भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक (RBI) का राष्ट्रीयकरण किस वर्ष किया गया था?
explainEn: The Reserve Bank of India, established in 1935 under the RBI Act, was nationalized on January 1, 1949.

qEn: Which vitamin is also known as Calciferol?
qHi: किस विटामिन को कैल्सीफेरोल के नाम से भी जाना जाता है?
explainEn: Vitamin D is a group of fat-soluble secosteroids known chemically as calciferol.

qEn: Which gas is most abundant in Earth's atmosphere?
qHi: पृथ्वी के वायुमंडल में कौन सी गैस सबसे अधिक मात्रा में पाई जाती है?
explainEn: Nitrogen makes up about 78 percent of Earth's atmosphere.

qEn: What is the standard unit of force in the International System of Units?
qHi: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय इकाई प्रणाली में बल (Force) की मानक इकाई क्या है?
explainEn: The SI unit of force is the newton, named after Sir Isaac Newton.

qEn: What is the chemical formula for washing soda?
qHi: वाशिंग सोडा (धोने का सोडा) का रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
explainEn: Sodium carbonate decahydrate is commonly known as washing soda, represented by Na2CO3.10H2O.

qEn: Which movement was suspended by Mahatma Gandhi following the Chauri Chaura incident in 1922?
qHi: 1922 में चौरी चौरा की घटना के बाद महात्मा गांधी ने किस आंदोलन को स्थगित कर दिया था?
explainEn: Mahatma Gandhi suspended the Non-Cooperation Movement due to the violence at Chauri Chaura police station in Gorakhpur district.

qEn: The Palk Strait separates India from which country?
qHi: पाक जलडमरूमध्य (पाक जलसंधि) भारत को किस देश से अलग करता है?
explainEn: The Palk Strait is a strait between the Tamil Nadu state of India and the Mannar district of the Northern Province of Sri Lanka.

qEn: Which constitutional amendment introduced the anti-defection provisions by adding the Tenth Schedule to the Constitution of India?
qHi: भारत के संविधान में दसवीं अनुसूची जोड़कर किस संवैधानिक संशोधन द्वारा दल-बदल विरोधी प्रावधानों की शुरुआत की गई थी?
explainEn: The 52nd Amendment Act of 1985 added the Tenth Schedule containing anti-defection laws to the Indian Constitution.
sourceHint: Indian Polity by M. Laxmikanth / Constitution of India

qEn: The 'Doldrums' refer to which of the following atmospheric pressure belts?
qHi: डोलड्रम्स (Doldrums) निम्नलिखित में से किस वायुमंडलीय दाब पेटी को संदर्भित करता है?
explainEn: The Doldrums is a popular term for the equatorial low-pressure belt characterized by calm winds and variable light breezes.
sourceHint: Certificate Physical and Human Geography by Goh Cheng Leong

qEn: Which committee was appointed by the Reserve Bank of India to review the governance of boards of banks in India?
qHi: भारत में बैंकों के बोर्डों के शासन की समीक्षा के लिए भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक द्वारा किस समिति को नियुक्त किया गया था?
explainEn: The P.J. Nayak Committee was constituted by the RBI in 2014 to review the governance of boards of banks in India.
sourceHint: RBI Official Reports / Indian Economy by Ramesh Singh

qEn: The 'Bhitarkanika Mangroves', a Ramsar site, are primarily associated with the deltaic region of which rivers?
qHi: रामसर स्थल 'भितरकनिका मैंग्रोव' मुख्य रूप से किन नदियों के डेल्टा क्षेत्र से जुड़े हैं?
explainEn: Bhitarkanika National Park is formed by the river deltas of Mahanadi, Brahmani, and Baitarani rivers in Odisha.
sourceHint: NCERT Class 9 Geography / Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

qEn: According to the Census of India 2011, which state recorded the highest population density per square kilometer?
qHi: भारत की जनगणना 2011 के अनुसार, किस राज्य ने प्रति वर्ग किलोमीटर सबसे अधिक जनघनत्व दर्ज किया?
explainEn: Bihar recorded the highest population density in India during the 2011 Census with 1,106 persons per square kilometer.
sourceHint: Census of India 2011, Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner

qEn: In the context of Indian classical dance, the term 'Abhinaya' primarily signifies what?
qHi: भारतीय शास्त्रीय नृत्य के संदर्भ में, 'अभिनया' शब्द का मुख्य अर्थ क्या है?
optsHi: भावपूर्ण अभिनय और भावना व्यक्त करना
explainEn: Abhinaya refers to the art of expression in Indian dance, used to convey the underlying meaning and emotion of a theme to the audience.
sourceHint: CCRT India Culture Modules / NCERT Fine Arts

qEn: Which fundamental right cannot be suspended even during a National Emergency declared under Article 352?
qHi: अनुच्छेद 352 के तहत घोषित राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल के दौरान भी किस मौलिक अधिकार को निलंबित नहीं किया जा सकता है?
explainEn: By the 44th Amendment Act of 1978, the right to protection in respect of conviction for offenses (Article 20) and the right to life and personal liberty (Article 21) cannot be suspended during a National Emergency.
sourceHint: Constitution of India, Part III & Part XVIII

qEn: Which vitamin is abundantly found in citrus fruits like lemons and oranges?
qHi: नींबू और संतरा जैसे खट्टे फलों में प्रचुर मात्रा में कौन सा विटामिन पाया जाता है?
explainEn: Citrus fruits are rich sources of Vitamin C, which is essential for immune health.

qEn: Which historical monument was built by Emperor Shah Jahan in Agra?
qHi: आगरा में सम्राट शाहजहाँ द्वारा किस ऐतिहासिक स्मारक का निर्माण किया गया था?
explainEn: The Taj Mahal was commissioned by the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan in Agra on the banks of the Yamuna river.

qEn: During the Gupta period, what was the term used for the land that was left uncultivated or fallow?
qHi: गुप्त काल के दौरान, उस भूमि के लिए किस शब्द का प्रयोग किया जाता था जिसे बिना जुताई या परती छोड़ा गया था?
explainEn: In Gupta era land revenue records, Aprahata referred to forest or wasteland that was left uncultivated.

qEn: Which of the following mountain passes connects the Kullu Valley with Lahaul and Spiti valleys in Himachal Pradesh?
qHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा दर्रा हिमाचल प्रदेश में कुल्लू घाटी को लाहुल और स्पीति घाटियों से जोड़ता है?
explainEn: Rohtang Pass is a high mountain pass on the eastern end of the Pir Panjal Range, connecting the Kullu valley with the Lahaul and Spiti valleys.

qEn: In the context of Indian monetary policy, which institution determines the Repo Rate?
qHi: भारतीय मौद्रिक नीति के संदर्भ में, रेपो रेट का निर्धारण कौन सी संस्था करती है?
optsEn: Securities and Exchange Board of India
explainEn: The Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) constituted under Section 45ZB of the RBI Act is entrusted with fixing the benchmark repo rate.

qEn: Which chemical compound is commonly known as 'Lunar Caustic'?
qHi: किस रासायनिक यौगिक को सामान्यतः 'लूनर कॉस्टिक' कहा जाता है?
explainEn: Silver nitrate (AgNO3) is known as lunar caustic because historically alchemists called silver 'luna'.

qEn: Who founded the 'Atmiya Sabha' in Kolkata in the year 1815?
qHi: वर्ष 1815 में कोलकाता में 'आत्मीय सभा' की स्थापना किसने की थी?
explainEn: Raja Ram Mohan Roy founded Atmiya Sabha in 1815 as a philosophical discussion circle in Kolkata.
sourceHint: Spectrum's A Brief History of Modern India

qEn: What is the primary ore of the metal Aluminium?
qHi: धातु एल्यूमीनियम का प्राथमिक अयस्क कौन सा है?
explainEn: Bauxite is the principal and most important ore of aluminium.
